name: dashboard-tiles
title: Dashboard Tiles
description: Dashboard pieces for a resource-kit app: a stat tile on its own card that can link to its source, a count tile that reads a resource total (optionally filtered), the latest records of a resource, and a grid that lays them out by its own width.
docs: Import: `import { DashboardGrid, ResourceCountTile, RecentRecords, StatTile } from '@/components/ui/dashboard-tiles'`. Render inside `ResourceKitProvider`: `<DashboardGrid><ResourceCountTile resource="deals" label="Open deals" filters={{ status: 'open' }} /><StatTile label="Revenue" value="$48,210" hint="This month" href="/invoices" /><RecentRecords resource="contacts" limit={5} /></DashboardGrid>`. Count tiles read `totalCount` from one-row `list` calls; `RecentRecords` follows the resource's `defaultSort` (or `createdAt` descending when there is none); pass `sort` to choose. `StatTile` also works without the provider.
